notes: The accessor range split leaves +0x18..+0x23 unmapped: getter ID 0x00..0x17 loads record+ID (main_0170.c:9396), and ID 0x18+ loads record+ID+0x10 (main_0170.c:9405), beginning at +0x28. Setter uses the same split (main_0170.c:9791, 9798). Header models the gap as 12 bytes (recovered/player_attributes_types.h:289).

Confirmed three one-byte signed inputs: getter sign-extends LD8 from +0x24, +0x25 and +0x26 (main_0170.c:9516-9536); setter writes individual bytes at +0x24, +0x25, +0x26 for derived IDs (main_0170.c:9817-9832). Thus int8_t[3] is justified. It ends at +0x26 and does not overlap +0x27 or +0x28. Header agrees (recovered/player_attributes_types.h:290).

Confirmed as a one-byte unmapped gap. Direct getter/setter IDs cover +0x00..+0x17 then resume at +0x28 via ID 0x18 (main_0170.c:9396, 9405, 9791, 9798); derived getter/setter bytes end at +0x26 (main_0170.c:9516-9536, 9817-9832). Therefore +0x27 is not part of the signed triplet and does not overlap +0x28. Header agrees (recovered/player_attributes_types.h:291).
